Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference you already have.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Conroe, Texas, heading east on the main road. The light had been green
for me when I entered.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. It came from my right side, from the cross street. I heard tires and then it hit my driver's side door.
Q: How fast do you think you were going?
A: Maybe the posted limit, or a little under. I wasn't rushing.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, and the airbags did not deploy, but the belt tightened hard across my chest.
Q: Did you get out of the car at the scene?
A: I did, but I felt stfif almost right away. My neck and lower back started hurting within an hour or so.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and they diagnosed a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical
therapy twice a week.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add about the accident itself?
A: Only that I've been careful to follow the treatment plan, and I'd like the other driver's insurance to know I was not at
fault.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>
